entries.title: AND.
entries.content:
AND. Numbers begins with "And", as all the books of the Pentateuch do. It is therefore one whole in five sections, rather than separate books.

the LORD spake = Jehovah (the Covenant God) spake to His own People. He spake fifty-six "sundry times" (7 x 8) in Numbers, and in thirteen "divers manners" (twelve to Moses, once to Aaron), and four times indefinite:. (1) To Moses alone (Numbers 1:1 , Numbers 1:48 ; Numbers 3:5 , Numbers 3:11 , Numbers 3:14 , Numbers 3:44 ; Numbers 4:21 ; Numbers 7:4 ; Numbers 8:5 , Numbers 8:23 ; Numbers 10:1 ; Numbers 11:25 ; Numbers 13:1 ; Numbers 16:44 ; Numbers 25:10 , Numbers 25:16 ; Numbers 26:52 ; Numbers 27:6 ; Numbers 31:1 , Numbers 31:25 ; Numbers 34:16 . (2) To Moses, to speak to Aaron (Numbers 8:1 ). (3) To Moses, to speak to Aaron and his sons (Numbers 6:22 ). (4) To Moses, to speak to Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest (Numbers 16:36 ). (5) To Moses, to speak to the Levites (Numbers 18:25 ). (6) To Moses, to speak to the congregation (Numbers 16:23 ). (7) To Moses, to speak to the children of Israel (Numbers 5:1 , Numbers 5:5 , Numbers 5:11 ; Numbers 6:1 ; Numbers 9:1 (Compare Numbers 1:4 ), 9; Numbers 15:1 , Numbers 15:17 , Numbers 15:37 ; Numbers 17:1 ; Numbers 28:1 (Compare Numbers 1:2 ); Numbers 33:50 ; Numbers 34:1 ; Numbers 35:1 , Numbers 35:9 ). (8) To Moses, to speak to the rock (Numbers 20:7 ). (9) To Moses and Aaron (Numbers 2:1 ; Numbers 4:1 , Numbers 4:17 ; Numbers 14:26 ; Numbers 16:20 ; Numbers 20:12 , Numbers 20:23 ). (10) To Moses and Aaron, to speak to the children of Israel (Numbers 19:1 ). (11) To Moses and Aaron and Miriam (Numbers 12:4 ). (12) To Moses and Eleazar (Numbers 26:1 ). (13) To Aaron (Numbers 18:8 ). (Numbers 1:20 should be "said".) (14) Jehovah spake (indefinite) (Numbers 1:19 ; Numbers 3:1 ; Numbers 14:35 ; Numbers 27:23 ). For "the LORD said", see note on Numbers 3:40 (sixteen times, making seventy-two in all).

Sinai. To which they had come on the third month after the exodus (Exodus 19:1 ), and where they abode till the twentieth day of the second month of the second year (Numbers 10:11 ). The numbering (Numbers 1 ) began on the first day of that month (Numbers 1:18 ).

entries.content:

entries.content:
these are the names. The order here = five sons of Leah, three of Rachel, one of Bilhah, two of Zilpah, and one of Bilhah. See App-45 for other orders of the names.

entries.title: Nahshon.
entries.content: Nahshon. In the line of the promised seed, the father of Salmon (husband of Rahab of Jericho), progenitor of Boaz of Bethlehem (husband of Ruth). Compare Ruth 4:18-22 .Matthew 1:4 , Matthew 1:5 .Luke 3:32 .

Simeon was greatly diminished by sin in Numbers 26:4 , and Moses does not mention him in Deuteronomy 33 .

Those that were numbered of them. Some codices, with two early printed editions, Targum of Onkelos, The Targum of Jonathan ben Uzziel Septuagint, and Syriac, omit this clause. Compare verses: Numbers 1:20 , Numbers 1:24 , Numbers 1:26 , &c.

entries.title: fifty.
entries.content: fifty. Gad is the only one who has "tens", all the others "hundreds". In the case of the firstborn (Numbers 3:43 ) we have not only tens but units.

entries.title: Judah.
entries.content: Judah. His number is greatest (Genesis 49:8 ).

entries.title: Joseph.
entries.content:
Joseph. "The fruitful vine" (Genesis 49:22 ) has two tribes (not merely "families"). Thus Joseph has "the double portion" (1 Chronicles 5:1 , 1 Chronicles 5:2 ).

Ephraim. Blessed first (Genesis 48:19 , Genesis 48:20 ), is here named first, and is increased more than Manasseh (Deuteronomy 33:17 ). But in journeyings his numbers were diminished by 8,000. See Numbers 26:37 , and compare 1 Chronicles 7:20-22 .

entries.title: Manasseh.
entries.content: Manasseh. The lowest in number. See Genesis 48:19 . Increased by 20,500 in journeying, Numbers 26:34 , Numbers 26:37 (compare Job 12:23 ).

entries.title: Of the children.
entries.content: Of the children. So in Authorized Version, and Revised Version, but not in Hebrew text, though it is so in some codices, Samaritan Pentateuch, Septuagint, Syriac, and Vulgate. Some Jewish commentators explain it as being only "the sons", because Naphtali had more daughters than sons, and in Gen 49:51 is likened to a female (hind). Hence in Numbers 26:64 it is said, the "men" died (but the women multiplied).

twelve men: one man for one tribe (Numbers 1:4 ).

men. Hebrew ' Ish . App-14 .

entries.content: all they. entries.content:

as = according as.

In the Zodiac, Ephraim and Manasseh are the two horns of Taurus, the bull. Ephraim, the younger, bears the standard, according to the blessing in Genesis 48:14-20 .

entries.title: Manasseh
entries.content: Manasseh , brother of Ephraim by same mother (Genesis 41:51 , Genesis 41:52 ). Sign, see Numbers 2:18 .

entries.title: Benjamin

entries.title: Dan.
entries.content: Dan. The centre on the north side. Colors of standard same as those of the third row of stones in Exodus 28:19 . Sign, the eagle (substituted for the serpent of Genesis 49:17 ). Compare Ezekiel 1:10 . Revelation 4:7 .

entries.title: Asher,
entries.content: Asher, the son of the other handmaid Zilpah, put with Dan and Naphtali, the sons of Bilhah. His sign was Sagittarius, the Archer.

entries.title: Naphtali.

As Aaron took part, according to Numbers 1:3 , Numbers 1:4 , and Numbers 4:41 , Numbers 4:45 , Numbers 4:46 , his name was included here by some ancient copyist; and later scribes dotted the words rather than leave them out.

entries.title: the LORD said
entries.content:
the LORD said = Jehovah said. Hebrew. 'amar (not davar, spake), 'amar is followed by the words spoken, davar is not. This expression, Jehovah said, occurs eighteen "sundry times" and in five "divers manners" in this book of Numbers. Compare note on Numbers 1:1

(1) To Moses (alone), Numbers 3:40 ; Numbers 7:11 ; Numbers 11:16 , Numbers 11:23 ; Numbers 12:14 ; Numbers 14:11 ; Numbers 15:35 ; Numbers 17:10 ; Numbers 21:8 , Numbers 21:34 ; Numbers 26:4 ; Numbers 27:12 , Numbers 27:18 . (2) To Aaron, Numbers 18:1 . (3) To Balaam, Numbers 23:5 , Numbers 23:16 . (4) He said, Numbers 12:6 . (6) I Jehovah have said, Numbers 14:35 .

With the fifty-six times "Jehovah spake" (See Numbers 1:1 ), these eighteen make seventy-four times, and sixteen manners. See note on Numbers 22:9 , for "God said" (four times, making seventy-eight in all).

See Isaiah 58:7 (Authorized Version "deal"); Jeremiah 16:7 (Authorized Version "tear"). Lamentations 4:4 .Ezekiel 18:7 (Authorized Version "given"). Me. Hence called "rebellion" in Numbers 20:24 with Numbers 27:14 . Compare Deuteronomy 32:51 . Compare "we" in Numbers 20:10 .

in the eyes, &c. His complaint in Numbers 11:21-23 was not public.

entries.title: Meribah
entries.content:
Meribah = contention. Psalms 106:32 , &c.

He was sanctified = He hallowed Himself. See note on "holy", Exodus 3:5 . Compare Ezekiel 38:23 .

entries.title: befallen us
entries.content: befallen us = "found us". Figure of speech Prosopopoeia. App-6 .

entries.title: behold.
entries.content: behold. Figure of speech Asterismos ( App-6 ), to emphasize the importance of the place. See notes on Numbers 20:1 .

entries.title: wells.
entries.content: wells. Hebrew. beer. See note on Genesis 21:19 .

entries.title: by me
entries.content: by me = through me. "Me" put by Figure of speech Metonymy (of Adjunct), App-6 , for "my country".

entries.title: without doing any thing else.
entries.content: without doing any thing else. Hebrew "without a word": i.e. without [saying] a word. Figure of speech Ellipsis. App-6 .

entries.title: turned away.
entries.content: turned away. Compare Judges 11:18 . Deuteronomy 2:4 , Deuteronomy 2:5 .

entries.title: Kadesh.
entries.content:
Kadesh. See notes on Numbers 20:1 , and Compare Numbers 33:37 .

Hor. Compare Numbers 33:37 .

entries.title: gathered.
entries.content:
gathered. Figure of speech Euphemismos ( App-6 ) for dying = die, and be buried as all his fathers were, Sheol being the grave. See App-35 . Compare Genesis 25:8 . Psalms 26:9 . Acts 13:36 .

word. Hebrew "mouth". Put by Figure of speech Metonymy (of Cause), App-6 , for what was spoken by it. Compare Numbers 20:12 .

entries.title: unto his people.
entries.content: unto his people. Figure of speech Ellipsis, supplied from Numbers 20:24 .

entries.title: as
entries.content: as = according as.

entries.title: top of the mount.
entries.content: top of the mount. Compare Genesis 8:4 ; Genesis 22:2 .Exodus 19 . Matthew 5:1 .Ezekiel 40:2 .Revelation 21:10 . Deuteronomy 34:1-5 .Matthew 17:1-3 .

entries.title: saw.
entries.content:
saw. Hebrew. ra'ah, to perceive, understand. Compare Genesis 16:13 ; Genesis 42:1 .Exodus 20:18 .

dead. The death of Aaron coincides with the end of the wanderings.

the house of Israel. See note on Exodus 16:31 ; one of the thirteen occurrences of the expression before the division of the two kingdoms; and compare note on 1 Kings 12:17 .

entries.title: Arad.
entries.content:
Arad. Compare Joshua 12:14 .

south = the Negeb. See Genesis 12:9 ; Genesis 13:1 , Genesis 13:3 ; Genesis 24:62 .Genesis 13:17 .

came = was entering.

way of the spies. Numbers 13:21 , &c. = "the way of the Atharim ", Septuagint so renders it, as a proper name; probably the name of the caravan route.

entries.title: vowed a vow.
entries.content:
vowed a vow. Figure of speech Polyptoton ( App-6 ), for emphasis = made a solemn vow.

the LORD. Hebrew. Jehovah. App-4 .

wilt indeed deliver = same Figure of speech Polyptoton ( App-6 ), only here it is translated and emphatically expressed by the word "indeed". Hebrew = "a delivering Thou wilt deliver".

entries.title: Canaanites.
entries.content:
Canaanites. The Septuagint and Samaritan Pentateuch add "into his (i.e. Israel's) hand".

and their cities. These destroyed after Israel came into the land. Compare Joshua 12:14 .Judges 1:16 , Judges 1:17 .

Hormah = utter destruction.

entries.title: soul.
entries.content:
soul. Hebrew. nephesh ( App-13 ).

discouraged = grieved or impatient.

entries.title: God
entries.content:
God = Elohim. They had lost sight of the covenant God, Jehovah.

Wherefore . . . ? Figure of speech Erotesis. App-6 .

our soul = we. Hebrew. nephesh. App-13 .

entries.title: fiery serpents
entries.content: fiery serpents = burning. Hebrew. nacheshim saraphim. Figure of speech Metonymy (of Effect), App-6 , because the effect of the bite was a burning sensation. Hebrew. saraph (see App-43 .) The Seraphim so called in Isaiah 6:2 , because they were burning ones: hence the name for these serpents. In the same way nachash, shining one, is also used for serpents, because they are shining ones in appearance. See Genesis 3:1 , and compare App-19 .

entries.title: said.
entries.content: said. See note on Numbers 3:40 .

entries.title: serpent
entries.content:
serpent = Hebrew. nachash, a shining thing of brass, as in Deuteronomy 8:15 . 2 Kings 18:4 , &c.: so that nachash is synonymous with saraph, and both words are thus used of serpents.

he lived. Compare John 3:14 , John 3:15 .

entries.title: children
entries.content: children = sons.

entries.title: coasts
entries.content: coasts = border.

entries.title: of the wars of the LORD.
entries.content:
of the wars of the LORD. This may commence the quotation, thus: "the wars of Jehovah [were with] Eth-Vaheb by the Red sea (or with a whirlwind. Hebrew. Supha. Compare Amos 1:14 .Isaiah 66:15 .Nahum 1:3 .Jeremiah 4:13; Jeremiah 4:13 ) and by the brooks of Arnon". Eth-Vaheb may be the proper name of the king of the Amorites, who took Heshbon, as in Numbers 21:26 .

the Red sea. Hebrew. Suphah, a city situated as described here, and in Deuteronomy 1:1 . Compare 1 Kings 9:26 .

the brooks of Arnon = the outpouring of the torrents.

entries.title: they went.
entries.content:
they went. This Ellipsis is wrongly supplied. It should be "from thence toward Beer". No mention is made of Beer in the list of journeys in Numbers 33 .

spake. See note on Numbers 1:1 .

entries.title: this song.
entries.content: this song. See note on Exodus 15:1 .

entries.title: they went.
entries.content: they went. No mention is made of any of these places in the itinerary in Numbers 33 . Why not supply "[the waters or streams] went" into all these places? See Numbers 21:16 . The Structure shows the scope of this member to be an "event"; "journeys" are the subject of the preceding member. Compare note on Exodus 15:27 . Note the Alternation, which gives the interpretation: The princes digged the well; The nobles of the people digged it, With the lawgiver [They digged it] with their staves.

entries.title: country
entries.content:
country = field.

Jeshimon = the wilderness.

entries.title: proverbs.
entries.content: proverbs. Hebrew poems.

entries.title: the lords.
entries.content:
the lords. Hebrew. Baalim.

high places. Compare Numbers 22:41 and Jeremiah 48:35 .

entries.title: We
entries.content:
We = Israel.

we have laid, &c , to end of verse. These two clauses are affected by the "extraordinary points" (see App-31 ), which necessitates the following rendering of Numbers 21:30 , "We have shot them down: Heshbon is destroyed even unto Dibon, The women also even unto Nopha, And the men even unto Medeba. "

entries.title: thou shalt do, &c.
entries.content: thou shalt do, &c. Compare Psalms 135:11 .

entries.title: children
entries.content:
children = sons.

plains of Moab: i.e. which had belonged to Moab.

entries.title: done to the Amorites.
entries.content: done to the Amorites. Compare Numbers 21:35 .

entries.title: all that are round about us:
entries.content: all that are round about us: Hebrew all our circuits. Figure of speech Metonymy (of Subject). App-6 .

entries.title: Balaam.
entries.content:
Balaam. So written after the Greek. In Hebrew bis name is Bil'am. Compare Joshua 13:22 with Joshua 24:9 , Joshua 24:10 ; 2Pe 2:15 , 2 Peter 2:16 . He was a spiritist or medium. He is identified by Sayce with Bela, Genesis 36:31 , Genesis 36:32 , where Moses incorporates a list of Edomite kings. According to the Tel-el-Amama tablets he was a Hittite chieftain, who established a kingdom for himself: and he died fighting against Israel by the side of his Midianite allies (Numbers 31:8 . Joshua 13:22 ).

his people: i.e. whom he had banded together and led. Some codices, with Samaritan Pentateuch, Syriac, and Vulgate, read "sons of Ammon".

entries.title: curse.
entries.content:
curse. Hebrew. 'arar. To wish or speak evil against, as to effect rather than as to the act.

wot = know.

entries.title: rewards of divination.
entries.content: rewards of divination. Hebrew "divinations". Figure of speech Metonymy (of Effect), App-6 , put for the money which procures it. Compare 2 Peter 2:15 .

entries.title: the LORD.
entries.content: the LORD. Hebrew. Jehovah. App-4 .

entries.title: God . . . said.
entries.content: God . . . said. Note the change to 'Elohim. said. Only four times: in verses: Numbers 9:12 , Numbers 9:20 in connection with Balaam. See App-4 , and notes on Numbers 1:1 ; Numbers 3:40 .

entries.title: there is a People.
entries.content:
there is a People. Hebrew = the People.

now. Some codices, with Samaritan Pentateuch, The Targum of Jonathan ben Uzziel and Septuagint, read "now therefore".

curse. Hebrew. kabab, to pierce with words. Note that this word is found only in Balak's and Balaam's mouths. Here, first occurrence, and later in seven other places. See note on Numbers 23:8 .

peradventure = perhaps.

entries.title: not go.
entries.content:
not go. This is absolute. Compare Numbers 22:20 , where the permission is conditional. See Structure above.

thou shalt not curse. A special various reading called Sevir (see App-34 ), with Samaritan Pentateuch, The Targum of Jonathan ben Uzziel Septuagint, Syriac, and Vulgate, read "neither shalt thou".

entries.title: Balaam . . . said.
entries.content: Balaam . . . said. Note what he suppressed,

entries.title: they . . . said.
entries.content: they . . . said. Note what they suppressed.

entries.title: promote thee unto very great honour.
entries.content: promote thee unto very great honour. Figure of speech Polyptoton ( App-6 ), for the emphasis rightly shown in the translation. Hebrew an honouring I will honour thee. See note on Genesis 26:28 .

entries.title: If the men come to call thee.
entries.content: If the men come to call thee. This was the condition with which Balaam did not comply. See Numbers 22:21 .

entries.title: went.
entries.content: went. Without waiting for the condition given by the LORD in Numbers 22:20 . Hence God's anger. See Numbers 22:22 .

entries.title: God's anger.
entries.content:
God's anger. Note 'Elohim, not Jehovah.

went = was really going. Emphasized to show that even this condition was not meant as a condition, but was to be taken rather as irony. It shows also Balaam's determination to go, whether or no.

stood = stationed himself.

entries.title: His sword drawn.
entries.content: His sword drawn. As in 1 Chronicles 21:16 . Balaam was going to have Israel killed with the sword.

entries.title: path
entries.content:
path = a narrow or hollow way. Hebrew. mish'ol. Occurs only here.

wall. Especially the wall of a vineyard. Compare Isaiah 6:8 .

entries.title: narrow.
entries.content: narrow. Hebrew. zarar. Occurs only here, Proverbs 23:27 , and Isaiah 28:20 .

entries.title: opened the mouth, &c.
entries.content: opened the mouth, &c. Hebrew. patah. Compare Numbers 22:31 . This was Jehovah's work (as in Numbers 22:31 ). But how could Satan open the mouth of the serpent, which has no organs of speech? See Genesis 3:1 , &c, and App-19 .

entries.title: opened
entries.content: opened = uncover. Hebrew. galah. Compare Numbers 22:28 .

entries.title: said.
entries.content:
said. See note on Numbers 3:40 .

Wherefore . . . ? Figure of speech Erotesis. App-6 .

behold. Figure of speech Asterismos. App-6 .

to withstand = to be an adversary, as in Numbers 22:22 .

perverse. Hebrew. 'avil. Occurs only here and Job 16:11 (ungodly).

entries.title: thee . . . her.
entries.content: thee . . . her. Note the emphasis on these pronouns.

entries.title: sinned.
entries.content: sinned. Hebrew. chata. App-44 .

entries.title: Go.
entries.content:
Go. Jehovah now overrules the evil for Israel's good.

men = Hebrew, plural of 'ish , or 'enosh. App-14 .

only the word. Permission limited.

entries.title: coast
entries.content: coast = border.

entries.title: Did I not earnestly send.
entries.content:
Did I not earnestly send. Figure of speech Polyptoton ( App-6 ), Hebrew "a sending did I not send". See note on Genesis 26:28 .

am I not able . . . ? Vain boast! Figure of speech Erotesis. App-6 .

entries.title: Lo.
entries.content:
Lo. Figure of speech Asterismos ( App-6 ).

have I. ? Figure of speech Erotesis ( App-6 ).

God = 'Elohim. Not Jehovah. Note this, and see App-4 .

entries.title: the utmost part
entries.content: the utmost part = the extremity of the camp.

entries.title: as
entries.content:
as = according to what.

offered = offered up. Hebrew. 'alah. See App-43 .

entries.title: the LORD.
entries.content:
the LORD. Hebrew. Jehovah. See App-4 .

meet: in a neutral sense. Hebrew. kar'a.

he went. Hebrew he went solitary. Compare Numbers 24:1 .

entries.title: God.
entries.content:
God. Hebrew. 'Elohim. See App-4 .

met: in a hostile sense. Hebrew. karah.

entries.title: put a word.
entries.content:
put a word. This is inspiration.

said. See note on Numbers 3:40 .

entries.title: lo.
entries.content: lo. Figure of speech Asterismos ( App-6 ).

entries.title: curse.
entries.content: curse. Hebrew. 'arar. See notes on Numbers 22:6 ; Numbers 22:11 .

entries.title: How . . . ?
entries.content:
How . . . ? Figure of speech Erotesis. App-6 .

curse = revile. Hebrew. nakab.

GOD = Hebrew. 'El = the mighty God. See App-4 .

cursed. Hebrew. kabab = to pierce with words.

defy . . . defied. Hebrew. za'am = to be enraged with.

entries.title: not be reckoned.
entries.content: not be reckoned. Therefore cannot be in the judgment of Matthew 25 , or confused with "the Gentiles, or with the church of God". 1 Corinthians 10:32 .

entries.title: Who can count. ?
entries.content:
Who can count. ? Figure of speech Erotesis. App-6 .

the number of = Who can number? Figure of speech Erotesis ( App-6 ). So with Samaritan Pentateuch and Septuagint. The word "number" is thought by Ginsburg to be an abbreviation of two words = "Who can number? "

me die = my soul die. Hebrew. nephesh. See App-13 .

righteous = upright. To die the death of the righteous one must have the righteousness of the righteous.

last end = latter end, i e. issue or reward.

entries.title: curse.
entries.content: curse. Hebrew. kabab. See note on Numbers 22:11 .

entries.title: burnt offering.
entries.content: burnt offering. Some codices, one early printed edition, with Samaritan Pentateuch and Syriac, read "offerings" ( plural ).

entries.title: Hath He said.
entries.content: Hath He said. Figure of speech Erotesis. App-6 .

entries.title: He hath blessed.
entries.content: He hath blessed. Samaritan Pentateuch and Septuagint read "I will bless".

entries.title: iniquity.
entries.content:
iniquity. Hebrew. 'avon, trespass. App-44 .

perverseness. Hebrew. 'amal. App-44 .

entries.title: strength
entries.content:
strength = heights or heaps of. Hebrew. to'apoth. Only here, Numbers 24:8 , Job 22:25 (plenty), and Psalms 95:4 (= heights).

unicorn. This word is from the Septuagint. The Hebrew is ree m. Supposed to be the rhinoceros, buffalo, or antelope: always rendered "unicorn" in Authorized Version.

entries.title: Jeshimon.
entries.content: Jeshimon. See note on Numbers 21:20 .

entries.title: offered
entries.content: offered = offered up. Hebrew. 'alah. App-43 .

entries.title: pleased the LORD.
entries.content:
pleased the LORD. Hebrew was good in the eyes of Jehovah.

the LORD. Hebrew. Jehovah. App-4 .

other times. Compare Numbers 23:3 , Numbers 23:15 , and see Structure (p. 215).

to seek for enchantments = to meet with familiar spirits (Deuteronomy 18:10 , Deuteronomy 18:14 ). Hebrew. nechashim, from nachash, a serpent. Compare Genesis 3:1 , and see App-19 .

entries.title: according to their tribes.
entries.content:
according to their tribes. Compare Numbers 2 .

the spirit of God (Hebrew. 'Elohim) . This expression occurs eight times outside the books of Samuel (Genesis 1:2 ; Genesis 41:38 . Exodus 31:3 ; Exodus 35:31 .Exodus 24:2 .Ezekiel 11:24 . 2 Chronicles 15:1 ; 2 Chronicles 24:20 ). In all other places it is "the spirit of Jehovah".

Spirit. Hebrew. ruach. App-9 .

upon. Always "upon "(not "in ") in Old Testament.

entries.title: And he took up his parable.
entries.content:
And he took up his parable. Compare Numbers 23:7 , Numbers 23:18 .

the man = the strong or mighty man. Hebrew. geber. See App-14 .

whose eyes are. Hebrew "whose eye is".

open. Hebrew. shatham, to close, i.e. "the man with closed eye", i.e. in an ecstasy; closed, but seeing.

entries.title: of.
entries.content:
of. Genitive of origin = words from God.

GOD = the mighty God. Hebrew. 'El. App-4 .

falling into a trance. The Ellipsis better supplied - "falling [to the ground]".

entries.title: How goodly.
entries.content:
How goodly. Figure of speech Thaumasmos. App-6 . This is only in "the vision of the Almighty".

Jacob. Figure of speech Metonymy (of Adjunct), put for posterity ( App-6 ).

And. This not to be in italics, according to some codices, with Samaritan Pentateuch, The Targum of Jonathan ben Uzziel Syriac, and Vulgate.

Israel. See note on "Jacob", Numbers 24:5 .

entries.title: As the trees of lign aloes, &c.
entries.content: As the trees of lign aloes, &c. Some codices, with The Targum of Jonathan ben Uzziel Septuagint, and Syriac, read "as tents which Jehovah hath pitched".

entries.title: pour the water.
entries.content: pour the water. This refers to Millennial blessings. See Ezekiel 4 7 and Zechariah 14 .

entries.title: him.
entries.content:
him. Some codices, with Targum of Onkelos, The Targum of Jonathan ben Uzziel and Syriac, read "them". Compare Numbers 23:22 .

unicorn. See note on Numbers 23:22 .

entries.title: He couched, &c.
entries.content:
He couched, &c. Compare Genesis 49:9 .

cursed . . . curseth. Hebrew. 'arar, execrate, chiefly as to its effect. See notes on Numbers 22:11 ; Numbers 23:8 .

entries.title: Balak's anger.
entries.content:
Balak's anger. See note on Exodus 10:28 .

curse = to pierce with words. Hebrew. kabab. See note on Numbers 22:11 .

behold. Figure of speech Asterismos. App-6 .

altogether blessed. Hebrew "a blessing thou hast blessed". Figure of speech Polyptoton. App-6 . See note on Genesis 26:28 .

entries.title: promote thee unto great honour.
entries.content:
promote thee unto great honour. See note on Numbers 22:17 , Numbers 22:37 .

lo. Figure of speech Asterismos. App-6 .

entries.title: the latter days
entries.content: the latter days = the end of the days, denoting a definite period. Compare Genesis 49:1 .Deuteronomy 4:30 . Isaiah 2:2 .Jeremiah 23:20 ; Jeremiah 30:24 ; Jeremiah 48:47 ; Jeremiah 49:39 . Ezekiel 38:16 . Daniel 10:14 .Hosea 3:5 .Micah 4:1 .

entries.title: Most High.
entries.content: Most High. Hebrew. Elyon, the High One over all the earth. See note on first occurrence, Genesis 14:18 . The Old Testament usage of this title is always in connection with dominion in the earth. App-4 .

entries.title: but not.
entries.content:
but not. Hebrew Who is not.

Star. Hebrew. kokab = Messiah. See Luk 1:78 . 2 Peter 1:19 . Revelation 2:28 ; Revelation 22:16 , and compare Matthew 2:2 . Sceptre. See note on Genesis 49:10 , and compare Psalms 2 .

corners = quarters.

destroy = subdue.

Sheth = Seth, i.e. all men, for all are now descendants of Sheth through Noah.

entries.title: Out of Jacob.
entries.content: Out of Jacob. In Hebrew there is the Ellipsis of the Participle ( App-6 ); "shall come "is implied and should be repeated from the previous clause. Revised Version is literal.

entries.title: the first:
entries.content: the first: i.e. the first that warred against Israel. Exodus 17:8 . Not the first in time or importance. shall be, &c. = "[shall be] destruction". Compare Exodus 17:16 .

entries.title: Kenites.
entries.content:
Kenites. With the word "nest" forms the Figure of speech Paronomasia ( App-6 ). Hebrew. ben kain.

nest. Hebrew. ken.

entries.title: took up.
entries.content:
took up. This is not a fifth parable, but part of the fourth.

live = survive.

entries.title: Chittim.
entries.content:
Chittim. A son of Javan, son of Japheth. Genesis 10:4 . Probably Cyprus, including north coast-line of Mediterranean, spelled Kittim in Genesis 10:4 and 1 Chronicles 1:7 .

afflict = humble.

Asshur = Assyrians.

Eber = the Hebrews.

he also: i.e. who sends the ships and humbled Asshur and Heber.

entries.title: abode:
entries.content:
abode: i.e. till after Moses' death. Compare Joshua 2:1 ; Joshua 3:1 , and see Micah 6:5 .

Shittim. Called Abel-shittim in Numbers 33:49 .

with = to (Hebrew. 'el). Requiring the supply of the Ellipsis "to join themselves to", from Numbers 25:3 .

entries.title: they:
entries.content:
they: i.e. the daughters of Moab.

their. Feminine pronoun.

entries.title: joined
entries.content:
joined = yoked.

Baal-peor. Baal = Lord; Peor was the mountain on which he was worshipped (Numbers 25:18 . Joshua 22:17 ). Baal was a Moabitish idol, and those who called (Numbers 25:2 ) the Israelites were the prostitutes necessary for his worship by others. Compare Hosea 9:10 . Jeremiah 11:13 . Peor also means "opening", and may have relation to this "worship".

anger of the LORD (Hebrew. Jehovah.

entries.title: said.
entries.content:
said. See note on Numbers 3:40 .

heads: i.e. chiefs or princes of the People. The number not stated here, but must have been 1,000, and included in the 24,000 of Numbers 25:9 , and excluded in 1 Corinthians 10:8 . The 23,000 mentioned in 1 Corinthians 10:8 "fell in one day": the day of the plague, verses: Numbers 25:9 , Numbers 25:18 . And those who were hanged prior to that (verses: Numbers 25:4 , Numbers 25:5 ) are not included.

hang them up: i.e. impaled or nailed to a stake, as in crucifixion (Vulg, renders it "crucify", which means the same thing).

entries.title: behold.
entries.content:
behold. Figure of speech Asterismos. App-6 .

children = sons.

who = and they.

door = entrance. Hebrew. 'ohel. App-40 .

tabernacle = tent.

entries.title: Phinehas.
entries.content: Phinehas. Compare Psalms 106:30 .

entries.title: tent.
entries.content:
tent. Hebrew. kubbah, a high and vaulted pleasure tent, used in the worship of Baal. Occurs only here.

belly. Hebrew. kobah, the part between the ribs, and loins. Occurs only here, for the Figure of speech Paronomasia ( App-6 ).

entries.title: twenty and four thousand.
entries.content: twenty and four thousand. This includes the 1,000 previously "hanged" (verses:Numbers 25:4; Numbers 25:4 , Numbers 25:5 ), as well as those who died of the "plague". These must have been 23,000 of 1 Corinthians 10:8 , which "fell in one day".

entries.title: spake.
entries.content: spake. See note on Numbers 1:1 .

entries.title: he shall have it.
entries.content:
he shall have it. See Psalms 106:30 , Psalms 106:31 , and Malachi 2:4 , Malachi 2:5 . Compare 1 Chronicles 6:4-15 . 1 Samuel 22:18 . 1 Kings 2:27 with 1 Samuel 14:17 . Also 1 Chronicles 6:4-15 . Ezra was of his line (Ezra 7:1 , Ezra 7:5 ).

everlasting priesthood. Restored to Phinehas, and remained with him, after Eli.

God. Hebrew. Elohim. App-4 .

atonement. See note on Exodus 29:33 .

entries.title: people
entries.content: people = clan or tribe. Hebrew. 'ummoth. Occurs only here, Genesis 25:16 and Psalms 117:1 .

entries.title: Vex.
entries.content: Vex. Compare Numbers 31 .

entries.title: wiles
entries.content:
wiles = seductions. Hebrew. nekal. Occurs only here.

day: i.e. the "one day" of 1 Corinthians 10:8 .

entries.title: after the plague.
entries.content:
after the plague. Compare Numbers 25:9 .

the LORD. Hebrew. Jehovah. App-4 .

spake. See note on Numbers 1:1 .

entries.title: Take the sum.
entries.content:
Take the sum. For the order of the tribes see App-45 . Moses received them by number, Exodus 38:26 ; so now, when preparing to die, he delivers them over by number. This was the third numbering.

children = sons.

their fathers' house: i.e. the families. These shown here to be fortyseven. In Genesis 46 they are fifty-two; so five are extinct (one of Simeon, one of Asher, and three of Benjamin).

entries.title: Take the sum of the people.
entries.content:
Take the sum of the people. This correctly supplies the Ellipsis from Numbers 26:2 . See Figure of speech Ellipsis, App-6 .

as = according to what.

entries.title: Reuben.
entries.content:
Reuben. Compare Genesis 46:8 . Exodus 6:14 . The order is the same as in Numbers 1:20 , except that Ephraim and Manasseh are reversed. See App-45 .

family. See note on "house", Numbers 26:2 , and throughout the chapter.

entries.title: Of Hezron
entries.content: Of Hezron = To Hezron [pertained], and so throughout. Compare verses: Numbers 26:12 , Numbers 26:13 , Numbers 26:15 , Numbers 12:16 , Num 12:17 , Num 12:20 , Num 12:21 , Num 12:23 , Num 12:24 , Num 12:26 , Num 12:28 , Num 12:29 , Num 12:30 , Num 12:31-32 .

entries.title: forty and three, &c.
entries.content: forty and three, &c. = 43,730 In = Num 1:2146 ; Num 1:500 , decrease of 2,770. This is an undesigned evidence of accuracy: an uninspired writer would have made an increase.

entries.title: sons.
entries.content: sons. A special reading of MS. called Sevir reads "son". See App-34 .

entries.title: which were famous, &c.
entries.content:
which were famous, &c. Hebrew "the called of the congregation". No Ellipsis.

strove = struggled. Hebrew. nazah. Compare Exodus 2:13 . Lev 24:10 . 2 Samuel 14:6 . Compare Numbers 16:2 , Numbers 16:3 .

entries.title: And the earth.
entries.content:
And the earth. This tenth verse is a Parenthesis. See App-6 .

sign: i.e. a warning.

entries.title: the children of Korah died not.

Of them came Samuel (compare 1 Chronicles 6:33 , 1 Chronicles 6:4 with 1 Samuel 1:20 ) and Heman (compare 1 Chronicles 6:33 with 1 Chronicles 25:4 , 1 Chronicles 25:6 ). Two groups of Psalms are associated with them (42-49 and 84-88).

six hundred, &c. = 601,730. In = Num 2:32603 ; Num 2:550 , total decrease 1,820. In Egypt they increased like fishes, Exodus 1:7 , now they decrease.

Compare Psalms 78:17-33 . Seven tribes increased (Judah, Issachar, Zebulun, Manasseh, Benjamin, Dan, Asher), total 59,200, beside the 1,000 Levites. Five tribes decreased (Reuben, Simeon, Gad, Ephraim, and Naphtali), total 61,020.

LEAH, increase: in Judah 1900, Issachar 9,900, Zebulun 3,100, Leviticus 1 ; and decrease in Reuben 2,770, Simeon 37,100. Total decrease 23,970. RACHEL, increase: in Manasseh 20,500, Benjamin 10,200; and decrease in Ephraim 8,000; total increase 22,700. ZILPAH, increase: in Asher 11,900; and decrease in Gad 5,150; total increase 6,750. BILHAH, increase: in Dan 1,700; and decrease in Naphtali 8,000; total decrease 6,300.

So, in the four camps: East camp, all increased; South camp, all decreased; West camp, Benjamin and Manasseh increased, Ephraim decreased; North camp, Dan and Asher increased, Naphtali decreased. On the whole, compare Job 12:9 , Job 12:10 , Job 12:14 , Job 12:23 .

entries.title: drive out.
entries.content: drive out. This was one of the great purposes for which the sword of Israel was raised up. Compare Deuteronomy 7:1 , Deuteronomy 7:2 .Exodus 23:33 . App-23 and App-25 .

entries.title: inhabitants of the land.
entries.content: inhabitants of the land. Figure of speech Ellipsis ( App-6 ) correctly supplied. Hebrew "land" is put by Figure of speech Metonymy (of Subject), for the inhabitants.

entries.title: ye shall divide.
entries.content: ye shall divide. Compare Numbers 26:53 .

entries.title: not drive out.
entries.content:
not drive out. Alas! they did not. Compare Joshua 13:13 ; Joshua 15:63 ; Joshua 16:10 . Judges 1:19 , Judges 1:21 , Judges 1:28 , Judges 1:29 , Judges 1:30-36 ; Judges 2:1-5 . See App-25 .

pricks. Compare Joshua 23:13 . = for pricks. Compare Ezekiel 28:24 .Judges 2:3 .

entries.title: the LORD.
entries.content:
the LORD. Hebrew. Jehovah. App-4 .

spake. See note on Numbers 1:1 .

entries.title: children
entries.content:
children = sons.

When ye come. After the final command (above) follow instructions as to the quiet possession of the land thus cleared of enemies.

coasts = borders, or confines.

entries.title: south quarter.
entries.content:
south quarter. Compare Joshua 15:1 . Begins at east corner.

salt sea. So Numbers 34:12 .

entries.title: Akrabbim
entries.content:
Akrabbim = Maaleh-akrabbim. Joshua 15:3 . = the ascent of scorpions. Compare Deuteronomy 8:15 .

going forth = ascending. Compare Joshua 15:3 .

entries.title: river.
entries.content: river. Hebrew. nachal, a wady; not nahar, a river. Here used of "Sihor", and called the river of Egypt. Compare Genesis 15:18 , where it is nahar = the Nile.

entries.title: great sea:
entries.content:
great sea: i.e. the Mediterranean, a modern name for the Great Sea.

point out = mark out or claim. Hebrew. ta'ah. Occurs only here.

mount Hor. Not the mount Hor where Aaron died, which was in the south corner of Edom (Numbers 33:37 , Numbers 33:38 ), but another, in the north, mount Hermon, a spur of the Lebanon (Joshua 13:5 ). Hermon had several names. Compare Deuteronomy 3:9 ; Deuteronomy 4:48 .

entries.title: Hamath.
entries.content: Hamath. In Amos 6:2 called "Hamath the great", mentioned as in the north border.

entries.title: Biblah.
entries.content:
Biblah. A city in Hamath, where God executed His judgment on two kings of Judah and others (2 Kings 23:33 ; 2Ki 25:6 , 2 Kings 25:20 , 2 Kings 25:21 .Jeremiah 39:5 , Jeremiah 39:6 ).

Chinnereth. Compare Joshua 12:3 ; Joshua 13:27 . In New Testament "the sea of Galilee" and "sea of Tiberias" (John 6:1 ); also "the lake of Gennesaret" (Luke 5:1 ).

entries.title: For the tribe.
entries.content: For the tribe. Compare Numbers 32:33 .Joshua 14:2 , Joshua 14:3 .

entries.title: These are the names.
entries.content:
These are the names. Compare Numbers 13:2-16 . See App-45 .

Eleazar. Because he was the high priest, and had the breastplate with the lots, the "Urim and Thummim. "See notes on Exodus 28:30 and Numbers 26:55 .Joshua 17:4 . See also Numbers 27:21 .

entries.title: Caleb.
entries.content: Caleb. The only one of the spies, beside Joshua, left, Ch. Numbers 13:6 , Numbers 13:30 , and Compare Numbers 14:24 .Joshua 14:6 , &c.

entries.title: These.
entries.content: These. See the order of the tribes in App-45 .

entries.title: the LORD.
entries.content:
the LORD. Hebrew. Jehovah. App-4 .

spake. See note on Numbers 1:1 .

entries.title: children
entries.content:
children = sons.

that they give. Jehovah gives to the Nation; the Nation gives to the Levites.

entries.title: suburbs
entries.content: suburbs = pasture grounds.

entries.title: cubits.
entries.content: cubits. See App-51 .

entries.title: to them.
entries.content: to them. A special various reading called Sevir ( App-34 ) reads "to you", with which agree some codices, Samaritan Pentateuch, The Targum of Jonathan ben Uzziel Septuagint, Syriac, and one early printed edition.

entries.title: six cities.
entries.content: six cities. See Deuteronomy 4:41 .Joshua 20:2 , Joshua 20:7 , Joshua 20:8 ; Joshua 21:3 .

entries.title: forty and eight cities.
entries.content: forty and eight cities. Compare Joshua 21:11 . So was Genesis 49:5 , Genesis 49:7 fulfilled, that Levi should be "divided in Jacob and scattered in Israel". At first a curse, but changed to a blessing on account of Exodus 32:26 , Exodus 32:29 .

entries.title: according to his inheritance.
entries.content: according to his inheritance. Nine from Judah and Simeon; four from Benjamin; four from Ephraim; four from Dan; two from the half of Manasseh; two from the other half; four from Issachar; four from Asher; three from Naphtali; four from Zebulon; four from Reuben; four from Gad. Compare Joshua 21:9 , Joshua 21:16 , &c.

entries.title: When ye be come.
entries.content: When ye be come. Compare Deuteronomy 19:2 .Joshua 20:2 .

entries.title: person
entries.content:
person = soul. Hebrew. nephesh. App-13 .

at unawares = by misadventure.

entries.title: avenger.
entries.content: avenger. Hebrew. Goel, to redeem, to ransom. First occurrence is Genesis 48:16 ; next, Exodus 6:6 ; Exodus 15:13 . Goel, when used in this connection, means to avenge bloodshed, as here; both were the duties of the next of kin, the kinsman. Our Goel not only redeems us from all evil, but avenges us of all our enemies. Romans 8:31-34 .

entries.title: three cities
entries.content:
three cities = Bezer, Ramoth, Golan (Deuteronomy 4:41-43 ).

and three = Kedesh, Shechem, Hebron (Joshua 20:7 ). These were placed in due order, east and west, in two ranks: Hebron over against Bezer. Shechem over against Ramoth. Kedesh over against Golan. If the Lord enlarged their land, they were to add three more (Deuteronomy 19:8 , Deuteronomy 19:9 ).

entries.title: person
entries.content: person = soul. Hebrew. nephesh. App-13 .

entries.title: revenger of blood.
entries.content: revenger of blood. See note on Numbers 35:12 ,

entries.title: of hatred.
entries.content:
of hatred. Deuteronomy 19:11 , Deuteronomy 19:12 .

laying of wait = fixing the eyes upon. Hebrew. zediyyah. Occurs only here and Numbers 35:22 .

entries.title: without enmity.
entries.content: without enmity. Compare Exodus 21:13 .

entries.title: was not his enemy.
entries.content: was not his enemy. Hebrew "he not [being] his enemy".

entries.title: statute of judgment
entries.content:
statute of judgment = a regulative ordinance. Compare Numbers 27:11 .

dwellings = dwelling-places.

entries.title: person
entries.content:
person = soul. Hebrew. nephesh. App-13 .

mouth. Put by Figure of speech Metonymy (of Cause), App-6 , for the evidence given by it.

entries.title: no satisfaction
entries.content:
no satisfaction = no ransom. Compare Psalms 49:7 . Only God can redeem (Numbers 35:15 ).

life = soul. Hebrew. nephesh. App-13 .

which is guilty of death = if he has unlawfully caused death: "guilty" being put by Figure of speech Metonymy (of Effect), App-6 , for the crime which has caused it. Hebrew "wicked, to die".

entries.title: priest:
entries.content: priest: i.e. the high priest. Some codices, with Samaritan Pentateuch, Septuagint, and Syriac, read it so, as in Numbers 35:28 .

entries.title: wherein ye are.
entries.content:
wherein ye are. Some codices, with Samaritan Pentateuch, Syriac, and Vulgate, read "wherein ye are dwelling".

blood: i.e. blood unlawfully shed.

him that shed it. Compare Genesis 9:6 .

entries.title: Defile not
entries.content:
Defile not = Defile thou not. Some codices, with Samaritan Pentateuch, Targum of Onkelos, The Targum of Jonathan ben Uzziel Septuagint, Syriac, and Vulgate, read "Defile ye not".

wherein = in the midst of which.

among = in the midst of.

entries.title: chief fathers
entries.content:
chief fathers = heads.

sons. A special various reading called Sevir ( App-34 ), with Syriac, reads "son", as in Numbers 36:12 .

children = sons.

entries.title: The LORD.
entries.content:
The LORD. Hebrew. Jehovah. App-4 .

my lord = Moses, to whom the commandment was given. Numbers 26:52 , Numbers 26:53 , &c.; Numbers 27:6 , Numbers 27:7 .

entries.title: jubile.
entries.content: jubile. Compare Leviticus 25 .

entries.title: word.
entries.content: word. Hebrew mouth. Put by Figure of speech Metonymy (of Cause), App-6 , for what is spoken by it.

entries.title: keep himself
entries.content: keep himself = cleave.

entries.title: man.
entries.content: man. Hebrew. 'ish. App-14 .

entries.title: These.
entries.content: These. This verse forms the closing Epilogue to the whole book of Numbers.
